label: Euler turbomachine equation
text: EN.O.A2.1.6 Euler turbomachine equation. For steady flow through a rotor, specific work done on the fluid is w = u₂c_θ2 − u₁c_θ1 (pump or compressor); for a turbine the extracted work is its negative.

warrant.standard: Validation against experiment with stated uncertainty (ASME V&V 20)
warrant.defeaters: Turbulence closure outside calibration; transition; multiphase; non-Newtonian fluid
